title: The Scaling Law
statement: Model loss falls as a power law in parameters, data, and compute — and all three must grow together or the gains stall.

title: The Data Wall
statement: Every model is bounded by the quantity and quality of text humans have actually written, and that supply is finite.

title: The Compute Tax
statement: Capability bought through scale is paid for in energy, silicon, and heat — costs that grow faster than the capability itself.

title: The Evaluation Gap
statement: A benchmark stops measuring capability the moment it becomes a target worth optimizing.
